title: Mean Position
description: Essential Criteria: The mean position of the particle must be correctly calculated as zero.

title: Mean Momentum
description: Essential Criteria: The mean momentum of the particle must be correctly calculated as zero.

title: Potential Function
description: Essential Criteria: The potential V(x) must be derived correctly as V(x) = (hbar^2 * gamma^4 * x^2) / (2m).

title: Momentum Probability
description: Essential Criteria: The probability P(p) must be correctly expressed as P(p) dp = (1/(hbar^2 * gamma^2 * pi)^(1/2)) * exp(-p^2/(hbar^2 * gamma^2)) dp.

title: Integration Steps
description: Important Criteria: Key integration steps for calculating mean position and momentum must be shown clearly.

title: Schrödinger Equation
description: Important Criteria: The application of the Schrödinger equation to derive V(x) must be correctly stated.

title: Normalization Constant
description: Optional Criteria: The normalization constant for the momentum wave function should be calculated and stated.

title: Fourier Transform
description: Optional Criteria: Mentioning the Fourier transform method to derive psi(p) from psi(x) is a useful addition.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Missing the correct sign or factors in the calculations for mean position or momentum will lead to significant errors.
